sentences.en: This is the fifth consecutive day of decline of stock prices.
sentences.zh: 这是股票价格连续第五天下跌。

sentences.en: Steel output set a record for two consecutive years.
sentences.zh: 钢铁产量连续两年创下了纪录。

sentences.en: Farmers in America face their fifth consecutive year of below-average income.
sentences.zh: 美国农民面临着连续第五年收入低于平均水平。

senses.zh: 连续的，连贯的；连续的，不间断的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con（加强）+secut（跟随）+ ive （…的）→一个接一个的→连续不断的
